name: Studied Mind
description: Gain proficiency in Investigation or History. If you already have proficiency, gain expertise instead.

name: Divine Lore
description: When you successfully research a creature, location, religion, or historical subject, ask the GM one additional question about the information discovered.

name: Read the Signs
description: Once per scene, when using Insight, Investigation, History, or Religion/Occult, you may draw an additional card and use it for the check.

name: Sacred Scholar
description: Learn one Tier 1 Divine spell. This spell is added to the spells available to your character.

name: Arcane Theology
description: When identifying or researching a magical effect, you may use Religion/Occult instead of Arcana when the subject has a divine or supernatural connection.

name: Keeper of Secrets
description: Once per scene, when you uncover information about an enemy, you may reveal one additional useful weakness, resistance, motivation, or capability.

name: Divine Channel
description: When casting a Divine spell, you may burn an additional Heart after paying the spell's normal cost. The additional Heart provides its normal resonant bonus.

name: Prophetic Insight
description: Once per short rest, ask the GM a single question about an immediate danger, creature, or situation. The GM must provide a truthful but appropriately limited answer.

name: Master of Lore
description: Gain expertise in one of the following skills: Arcana, History, Investigation, or Religion/Occult.

name: Ancient Knowledge
description: When you successfully research a subject, the GM may provide a deeper connection to the world: a forgotten weakness, lost location, ancient name, hidden faction, or other significant revelation.

name: Divine Warrior
description: Gain proficiency with Spade weapons.

name: Armored Faith
description: Gain proficiency with Heavy Armor.

name: Battle Prayer
description: Before making a Might attack, you may burn a Heart instead of another card. If the attack hits, deal 1 additional HP.

name: Shield of Faith
description: When you use Dodge, you may protect an adjacent ally instead of yourself.

name: Holy Strike
description: When you make a Might Strike with a Heart card, deal 1 additional HP on a hit.

name: Battlefield Chaplain
description: When an ally within close range reaches 0 HP, you may immediately use an appropriate Divine ability or spell that restores HP if you can pay its cost.

name: Rallying Faith
description: When you use Rallying Cry, one of the affected allies may also recover 1 HP.

name: Divine Retribution
description: Once per short rest, when an enemy damages you, you may burn a Heart to make an immediate Divine attack against that enemy.

name: Unbreakable Faith
description: When you would be reduced to 0 HP, burn a Heart. You remain at 1 HP instead. Once used, this feat cannot be used again until a Long Rest.

name: Champion of War
description: When you make a melee attack using a weapon associated with your proficient suit, you may treat a face card as a powerful special attack. The GM determines an appropriate additional combat effect.
